objectives.description: Learning objectives or goals the assignment is meant to achieve.

deliverables.description: Concrete artifacts the student must submit (essay, report, code, slides, etc.).

grading_rubric.description: Rubric criteria with their weight as percentage (0-100). Weights should sum to ~100.

technical_requirements.description: Tools, languages, libraries, formats, page/word counts, citation styles, etc.

estimated_hours.description: Realistic total hours needed for a competent student to complete this work end-to-end.

keywords.description: 5-10 topical keywords for resource lookup downstream.
